draft_text: On identical hardware at batch size 16, Nimbrake delivers higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, at 142 versus 119 requests per second.
revised_text: On the same Orison AX7 accelerator, Nimbrake measured 142 requests per second at batch size 32 and Caskline measured 119 requests per second at batch size 16 on Driftbay-Serve; because the batch sizes differ, the throughput figures are not directly comparable.
rationale: The table note states Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16, so the throughput figures are not directly comparable. The claim's "at batch size 16" for Nimbrake and the direct comparison are unsupported. Numbers 142 and 119 are correct.
